lines.say: Cheap grain through ration shops is old.
Making it a legal entitlement came in 2013.

beats.say: Cheap grain through ration shops is old. Making it a legal entitlement came in 2013.

lines.say: The Act covers up to 75 percent of the rural population
and up to 50 percent of the urban population.

beats.say: The Act covers up to 75 percent of the rural population and up to 50 percent of the urban population.

lines.say: Priority households get 5 kilograms of grain per person, every month.
The poorest, Antyodaya households, get 35 kilograms per household.

lines.say: Pregnant women and mothers get a maternity benefit of at least six thousand rupees.
And children get meals through anganwadis and schools.
